name: AUCTION
source:
Main characters lives with maid and an older sister and leads a normal school life. But something starts to change. His sister is approached by a shady man and shy classmates start to behave proactively. Then one morning maid brings him an anonymous letter saying "Auction". This story starts at this moment, two weeks before protagonist's birthday.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-july-2004-dear-my-friend.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
男主角平日与姐姐及女仆同住一个屋檐下，过着平凡安稳的校园日常。然而异变悄然浮现：先是形迹可疑的陌生男子频频接近姐姐，紧接着原本内向害羞的女同学也反常地主动投怀送抱。直到某个清晨，距离男主角生日还剩两周之时，女仆递来了一封只写着“拍卖”二字的匿名信——整个故事便从这一刻正式拉开帷幕。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-july-2004-dear-my-friend.html]vndbreview[/url]]
